claim: Global CTS admissibility for two additional structured mixed-symbol inputs; not a Rule 110 correctness proof.

proofs.argument: At each aligned three-step rotation, exactly one complete three-letter block is consumed. It contains Y, so at least one nonempty appendant is appended. Every appended word consists of at least two whole three-letter blocks, each containing Y. Thus the block property is preserved, the block count increases by at least one, and the tape never empties, including inside a rotation.
